name: Project Slayers
desc:
✨ Step into a world where demons lurk in the shadows and only the strong survive. In this fast-paced RPG, you’ll forge your own blade, master powerful breathing styles, and face deadly enemies across dark forests and distant lands. ✨

Choose your path: protect humanity or embrace the darkness.
Your story… your fate. 😈

🖥️ [Default Controls]
M1 – Attack (Left Click)
M2 – Heavy Attack (Right Click)
M – Open Menu
Q – Dash
CTRL – Wall Climb
Left Shift – Sprint
Left Alt – Mouse Lock

🎮 [Combo Variations]
LRLRL or SPACE – Air Combo
RRLRL – Special Combo
LLRLR – Special Combo
